top_reviews.title: Perfect Jeans!
top_reviews.body: Wow! I’m blown away be these jeans! The color, the fit, the style… everything I wanted. I bought the brown in an XL; I wear 14-16 in jeans and wasn’t sure how the sizing for these would compare. Again, the fit is perfect. The color is a lovely chocolate brown, which coincidentally goes perfectly with this LOMON top: LOMON Women's 3/4 Sleeve Cotton... https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H4R67MKT?ref=ppx_pop_mob_ap_share. The fabric is soft & stretchy with a quality feel. The fit is genuinely high waisted with straight legs, not the wide-leg look that is beautiful on skinny girls but not so flattering on us plus size girls. The fringe hem is fairly conservative and on point for the style and today’s trends. I couldn’t be happier with these jeans and will be buying other colors.

top_reviews.title: Your new favorite pants
top_reviews.body: These pants fit so good and are comfortable right away. They don't need to be broken in at all. They are not flattering for the booty at all. They flatten the shape. The legs at the bottom flare more than pictured. These give off an old school 90s fit and I love that. The crotch fit for ladies is perfectly fitted. I definitely own more than one pair in different colors. Pros: comfortable, stretchy, colors are great and the crotch fit for ladies is perfect! Cons: flattening to the booty, the bottoms fold up and won't lay flat, flare can make you look heavier

top_reviews.title: Better than expected
top_reviews.body: Actually shocked how nice these fit. No tummy control whatsoever but really flattering cut in the back and soft and stretchy fabric. A little grossed out by the (dog???) hairs all over these pants. But nothing the wash won’t fix.

top_reviews.title: Perfect Pink jeans!
top_reviews.body: I absolutely love these pink jeans! The color is so pretty and fun, and they’re such an easy way to make an outfit stand out. The high-waisted fit is flattering, and the straight-leg style looks great with both heels and sneakers. They’re comfortable, stylish, and I’ve already gotten so many compliments. Such a great pair of jeans!

top_reviews.title: Waist runs very small
top_reviews.body: The style, color, shape, stitching, length, etc. were all great. However, know this is more Miss sizing vs woman sizing. The XL is more like a women’s 14 vs 16-18 in the waist. I should have read the size chart instead of getting my normal size. They fit everywhere else, but waist was about 4 inches too small.

top_reviews.title: Most Comfortable Jeans Ever
top_reviews.body: I am 5’4, 210lbs with thick legs, almost 75 years old. I bought xxl. A tiny bit long to wear with sandals but I have short legs and that is easily fixed by hemming, perfect length with heels and sneakers though, so may just leave them be and roll up with sandals. I like the raw edge. These jeans are perfect for me. Soooo comfy and stylish, love the wide legs, not super wide like some are, just right, maybe the most comfortable I have ever had because of the stretch. I cannot stand anything tight on my body. I would recommend these highly. Love the light blue color too. Great quality and medium weight. Will purchase more in other colors. Back again to add to previous review. After I had these jeans on for a little while they loosened up and I realized I should size down because they were slipping down on me. I still love the jeans but ordered a size smaller and they are perfect. This time I bought xl in vintage blue…love them. Not much difference in the size but just enough to make them stay up. The length is better for me too. 100% recommend. I just ordered the ice blue again in xl. I would consider other colors too.

top_reviews.title: Good fit and comfortable stretch
top_reviews.body: Comfortable jeans! I bought size Medium in both Washed Black and Brown colors. No variance in fit between the colors. For reference, I am 5'ft 4" tall, and currently weigh 150 lbs. I am not particularly curvy, just average. The length of these jeans is perfect for me. I am losing weight (by choice) so my opinion re: length and fit may change over time, but since they have a cut, finged hem that will not be a problem. I can simply cut the leg length shorter, and will just cinch up the waist with a belt. These jeans should last me a good while. I like the colors. I am a senior woman and only wear high waisted pants.

top_reviews.title: Love these jeans and I will buy more!
top_reviews.body: Great jeans. They feel soft and worn in. Love the fit - and I'm a challenge when it comes to jeans fitting! I'm short, though, so these are a good 2-1/2" too long for me. I will likely just hem them -- I don't know that I can cut them shorter and still get a proper fray edge. My sister asked me to send her a link- and already the price had gone up about $10 since I ordered less than 10 days ago. The price history show a frequent fluctuation. Put them in your cart and watch for a price change. I'm ordering more.
